actions: Opened Automation and Trade Station through real browser controls.

Fixture Resource Crate became checked through the production onChange path.
Exclusive-only Fixture City-Owner Offer was hidden by default, appeared when Show city-owner exclusive was checked, and remained disabled with the skipped-exclusive label.

actions: Selected Fixture Speedup Chest through the visible goods card.
Clicked the shared Retry button after the injected first save failure.
Reloaded the fixture, repeated the real goods selection to recreate the first-save failure, then clicked Discard unsaved changes.
observed: The selection failure surfaced Changes have not been saved with Retry and Discard unsaved changes.
Retry cleared the error and retained Fixture Speedup Chest checked.
Discard cleared the error and restored Fixture Speedup Chest unchecked.
